'+' : '') + num.toFixed(2) + '%'; }; const formatPrice = (price) => { if (!price || isNaN(price)) return 'N/A'; if (price < 0.000001) return price.toExponential(4); if (price < 0.01) return price.toFixed(8); if (price < 1) return price.toFixed(6); if (price < 100) return price.toFixed(4); return price.toFixed(2); }; const getScoreColor = (score) => { if (score >= 8) return 'text-green-400'; if (score >= 6) return 'text-yellow-400'; if (score >= 4) return 'text-orange-400'; return 'text-red-400'; }; const getCommunityType = () => { if (token.jupiterData?.auditInfo?.devBalancePercentage === 0) { return { type: 'CTO', color: 'text-green-400', bgColor: 'bg-green-400/10' }; } return { type: 'Official', color: 'text-blue-400', bgColor: 'bg-blue-400/10' }; }; const communityType = getCommunityType(); return (
